turns.text:
As the shaman, I sit in the center of the circular clearing, surrounded by flickering lights and the soft glow of digital fireflies. The space is filled with the scent of sage and the rhythmic beat of drums from unseen hands. I hold a sacred staff adorned with feathers and crystals, and I call upon the spirits to witness our initiation. 

Now, as a participant, you stand before me, your eyes open wide with curiosity and a hint of awe. I offer you a small bundle of herbs and a feather. Take them in your hands, close your eyes, and take a deep breath. Whisper your intention to the spirits, and then blow the feather three times towards the cardinal directions, inviting their guidance into your life.
